spans.s:
mfn. (-र्ब्बः-र्ब्बा-र्ब्बं)
Dwarfish, a dwarf.
n. (-र्ब्बं)
A billion.
E.
नि certainly, verily, खर्ब्ब short, &c.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Dug, dug up, excavated.
2 Fixed in the ground as a stake.
E.
नि before खन to dig, क्त aff.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
All, entire, complete.
E.
नि negative, खिल defective.
